title: Tell Me Who You Really Are
excerpt: “Tell Me Who You Really Are” invites viewers to explore the journey of self-discovery and empowerment — celebrating the connection between body and soul.

body.x: (A Collection of Four Artworks - Tell Me Who You Really Are _01, Tell Me Who You Really Are_02, Tell Me Who You Really Are_03, Tell Me Who You Really Are_04)

"Tell Me Who You Really Are" invites viewers to explore the journey of self-discovery and empowerment. These artworks celebrate the connection between body and soul, encouraging us to embrace our true selves, let go of masks, and find strength in who we are. It is all about discovering the strength within our soul and body. It explores how we see ourselves, how we grow, and how we connect with who we truly are. Each artwork shows a moment where our inner self and outer self come together, revealing the beauty and power of being authentic.

It begins with a dreamlike moment: figures moving gracefully across reflective salt flats, their forms blooming like flowers. This symbolizes the beauty of growth and stepping into your true self. Then, it moves inward—to a woman surrounded by faces and shadows, capturing the struggle we all face in peeling back layers to see the real person underneath.

The journey doesn't stop there. It becomes about connection as radiant figures walk together under a glowing sunset. Their presence is a celebration of individuality but also the strength we find in unity and shared experiences. Finally, the series closes with the intense gaze of two leopards—fierce, wild, yet reflective. They remind us of the duality within us all: the untamed spirit and the quiet, thoughtful self.
Each piece is a step in this exploration, inviting you to reflect, to feel, and to ask yourself: "Who am I, really?"
